app.name: Download Manager
options.title: Download Manager — Settings
options.rules.heading: Per-type download rules
options.rules.desc: The first matching rule wins. Downloads that match no rule are left to Chrome.
options.rules.label: Label
options.general.captureDesc: Matching downloads are canceled in Chrome and handled by this extension.
options.general.probeDesc: Send a ranged request first to check whether the server allows multiple connections.
options.general.fallback: Fall back to a single connection
options.general.fallbackDesc: Used when the server does not support ranged requests.
options.general.maxConcurrentDesc: Total number of files downloading at once.
options.general.retriesDesc: Attempts per segment before the download fails.
options.general.minSegmentSizeDesc: Files are split into fewer segments rather than going below this size.
error.sizeMismatch: The server reported a different file size
error.storage: Could not write to local storage
prompt.title: Download Manager
prompt.question: Download this file with Download Manager?
options.general.captureModeDesc: Rules decide which downloads this applies to.
options.general.detectMediaDesc: Lists HLS streams and large video files found on the page. YouTube is excluded.
options.general.clipboardWatchDesc: Only short http(s) URLs copied on a page are read; nothing else leaves the page.
options.general.remuxDesc: Rewraps MPEG-TS segments as MP4. Video and audio are copied, not re-encoded.
prompt.questionMedia: Download this video from the page?
options.general.askMedia: Ask about videos found on pages
options.general.askMediaDesc: Shows the same card when a stream is spotted. Off means they are only listed in the popup.
